t: The Oakey 80 Grit Multi-Material Sanding Roll is a versatile abrasive designed for efficient material removal and surface preparation. This durable sanding roll, measuring 10m by 115mm, features an E-Weight paper backing and 80 grit aluminium oxide, making it suitable for a wide range of applications. Its anti-clogging and self-sharpening properties ensure consistent performance and extended life, whether used for hand sanding or with power tools. Ideal for trade professionals working on wood, paint, metal, and plaster, this dry-use sanding roll provides reliable results across various projects.
b: Suitable for Sanding Wood, Paint, Metal & Plaster
